name: Turbo Dodge 3D
description: High-speed 3D arcade racer built with Three.js featuring dynamic 3D chase, hood, and retro camera angles, custom 3D car models (F1 open-wheel, supercharged V8 muscle, armored heavy trucks, GT supercars, zero-G hovercrafts), real-time 3D lighting and shadows, close-pass near-miss bonuses, 3D particle bursts, and synthesized Web Audio sound profiles.
